news.content: Following the release of SpaceX's third-quarter 2026 financial results, several analysts have updated their outlook on the company. UBS maintained a Buy rating while raising its price target to $230 from $210. Additionally, Wells Fargo maintained an Overweight rating and increased its price target to $274 from $214. These adjustments reflect analyst reactions to the company's reported revenue growth and strategic focus on artificial intelligence.
news.headline: Analysts Adjust Price Targets for SpaceX Following Q3 Results
news.summary: Financial institutions including UBS and Wells Fargo have updated their price targets for SpaceX following the company's third-quarter earnings report.

news.author: Badar Shaikh
news.content: It was yet another eventful week for Tesla Inc (NASDAQ:TSLA) and CEO Elon Musk amid the Roadster's high-flying debut, questions about a possible SpaceX merger and more.
news.headline: This Week in TSLA: Roadster's Flying Debut, Cybercab Speeding in School Zones, SpaceX Merger and More
